We need a better photo

To get an accurate analysis, please upload a well-lit, front-facing photo with a neutral expression (no smiling).

  • Face the camera straight on (no head tilt)
  • Neutral expression — no big smile
  • Keep both eyes open
  • Good even lighting, no harsh shadows
